title: Position, speed & time
description: A compact position report with time, receiver status, speed over ground and course over ground.

fields.name: UTC time
fields.description: Time of the position fix, hhmmss with optional fractional seconds.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: A indicates active data; V indicates void data.

fields.name: Speed over ground
fields.description: Knots; movement relative to the ground.

fields.name: Course over ground
fields.description: Direction of travel, measured clockwise from true north.

fields.name: Date
fields.description: ddmmyy; the century is not encoded.

fields.name: Magnetic variation
fields.description: Magnitude in degrees; may be empty.

fields.name: Variation direction
fields.description: E or W; may be empty.

fields.name: Mode (optional)
fields.description: Receiver mode; availability depends on version.

notes: Course over ground describes travel direction, not the direction the bow points. An active status does not establish positioning accuracy.
